arms.naive: no context control, no critic, unbounded budget — the default most demos ship
arms.ballast: default runtime: offload + compaction + retrieved briefing + one critic round
arms.no_offload: tool outputs stay verbatim in the transcript
arms.no_context_control: both offload and compaction disabled, everything else identical to ballast
arms.tight_budget: budget too small to finish naively; forces soft degradation
arms.no_budget: no ceiling at all, for the cost of the same policy without control
arms.defective: policy that skips the mandatory computation step (guardrail target)
arms.bloated: policy that pulls whole lists instead of one record
